title: The Secret Life of Words: Kosztolányi's Poetics
grammar: Expressive Register and Affective Stylistics: Kosztolányi's Poetics
goal: I can explain how Kosztolányi wrote about the sound and feel of Hungarian words.

I can describe the sound, feeling and rhythm of a Hungarian word.
